details: golden [1,144,8400] RM rows 64-144: tile counter underflowed on ack

text: implicit-sync entries larger than the 8 KiB overlay packet miscount the ISR threshold; probes: 8192 B ok, 8256/12288/16384/16832 B fail with block>=2
explicit sync (block-batched reserve/barrier/push, wait/barrier/pop) for entry_bytes > 8 KiB; ring opted out via disable_dfb_implicit_sync_for; R==W required on that path

details: acceptance 13/13, plan/session tests 64, golden 72 passed / 412 xfail / 0 fail

what: Nothing says an implicit-sync ring entry must fit one NoC overlay packet (NOC_OVERLAY_MAX_BYTES_IN_PACKET = 8 KiB, tt_metal/hw/inc/internal/tt-2xx/quasar/noc_cmd_buf_common.h:74). Entries over 8 KiB (measured 8,256 to 16,832 B, row-major bf16 rows wider than 4096) end in tile counter underflowed or a hang once a block holds 2 or more entries. The planner therefore capped entries at the 64 KiB burst, and the gap only showed on a traced PHASE0 cell in the golden suite.
suggest: Add a library-gaps entry and one line on the target page: implicit sync needs entry_size <= 8 KiB; use explicit sync, block-batched (reserve/barrier/push), for larger entries. Probes: tests/ttnn/unit_tests/operations/slice/probes/probe_002..004.py
